We use Information Overlap (IO) as our primary evaluation method. We use different strategies to evaluate the queries depending on the query type. For queries with subjective or lengthy answers... we use BERTScore with the microsoft/deberta-xlarge-mnli model... For keyword match, α and θ are not applied.
